record.label: Variance-floor equality and correlation-gauge amplification
record.summary: Three original witnesses had variance minima just above 1e-30 (1.0000000000000003e-30, 1.0000000000000008e-30, and 1.0000000000000004e-30), so an exact equality check missed the floor event. Subsequent correlation normalization amplified tiny denominators into parent-repair excursions 0.00249167098660108, 0.008121398313472243, and 0.010735367118163627. Changing only variance==floor to variance<=2*floor repairs all three trajectories from 7.825e-7/9.667e-6/3.392e-4 to ordinary e-8 values.
record.terminal_criterion: Preserve the <=2*floor trigger and the byte-identical normal branch; do not generalize beyond the measured near-floor correlation-gauge mechanism.
